mcpTools.description: Pay-Safe verdict (ALLOW / WARN / DENY) for an x402 402 challenge: price, token and endpoint against the listing, payee against the expected wallet, EIP-712 domain against the token contract, shell payloads, signed EIP-3009 / Permit2 payloads. Nothing is signed or paid. Free.

inputSchema.description: Pass paymentRequired (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header or 402 body) or payment (flattened quote).

feeAmount.description: Listed price in human units, e.g. 0.005

payTo.description: Wallet the buyer expects to pay

payment.description: Flattened quote: network or chainId, asset, amount (atomic), payTo, scheme, maxTimeoutSeconds, extra

paymentRequired.description: Base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header or the 402 JSON body

paymentSignature.description: Signed PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT to verify before replay

selectedIndex.description: accepts[] entry you intend to pay

mcpTools.name: check_payment

mcpTools.description: Guardian requests the paid URL once without paying (GET, POST or MCP tools/call), captures the x402 challenge and returns the Pay-Safe verdict. URLs with shell syntax are never contacted. Free.

feeAmount.description: Listed price in human units, e.g. 0.005

payTo.description: Wallet the buyer expects to pay

params.description: Business params: query for GET, JSON body for POST

tool.description: MCP tool name when the endpoint is an MCP server

url.description: https URL of the paid endpoint

mcpTools.name: probe_payment

mcpTools.description: Reads the transaction receipt and confirms the ERC-20 Transfer matches the checked payee, atomic amount and token (x402 settlement is submitted by a facilitator). Default chain X Layer (196), default token USD₮0. Free.

amount.description: Atomic amount that was checked, e.g. "5000"

token.description: Token address, default USD₮0 on X Layer

mcpTools.name: verify_settlement

mcpTools.description: Latest Pay-Safe trust-scan result for an OKX.AI marketplace service id (sid): verdict, reasons and findings of its x402 challenge against its own listing, with the scan date. Free.
mcpTools.name: check_listing

mcpTools.description: Is it safe to send to, approve or call this address? Contract code, history, lookalikes of known contracts, shared threat registry and the ScamSniffer database. Free.
mcpTools.name: check_address

mcpTools.description: Phishing patterns, trusted list, shared threat registry and the ScamSniffer phishing database for a domain or URL. Free.
mcpTools.name: check_domain

mcpTools.description: Security verdict for an EVM transaction: unlimited or wallet-targeted approvals, address poisoning, drains hidden in multicall and router plans, known drainers, optional simulation when from is given. Free.

context.description: Agent context: agent_goal, recent_sources, recent_tool_calls, session_id, known_addresses, expected_amount

mcpTools.name: analyze_transaction

mcpTools.description: Security verdict for EIP-712 (permit, Permit2, Seaport, SIWE), personal_sign and eth_sign requests. Free.
mcpTools.name: analyze_signature

mcpTools.description: Premium transaction or signature verdict with session health, owner alerts, reference-template diff and shared threat intelligence. Paid per call over x402 on X Layer (exact scheme, USD₮0), settled by the OKX facilitator. Same arguments as analyze_transaction, or kind "signature" with analyze_signature arguments.

type.description: Signature type when kind is signature

mcpTools.name: guard

data.nextStep: onchainos payment quote https://guardian-mcp-rho.vercel.app/mcp --tool <name> [--param k=v] — pick a tool to trigger its 402
data.summary: MCP server exposes 9 tool(s): check_payment, probe_payment, verify_settlement, check_listing, check_address, check_domain, analyze_transaction, analyze_signature, guard
